d: Bihar ke saharsa jile ke saurbajar nagar panchayat men bhrashtachar ke khilaph patna nigrani anveshan byuro ne bari karravaee ki hai. pradhanmantri aavas yojna ke tahat labhukon se aavas ki kisht jari karne ke evaj men 72 hajar rupye rishvat lete hue aavas sahayak mukul kumar ko nigrani ki tim ne range hath daboch liya.
